summary: This guide showcases early Week 1 Level 59 team setups for Vortex 1 in Season 9 using Aura and Toxin compositions. Aura with Toxin performs better than Dauntless during early Season 9 because Dauntless lacks critical damage conversion talents early on. The video details specific gear, artifacts, skill timings, and replacements for two 5-man teams: an Aura team featuring the new Ice support Celestine and a Toxin team utilizing Child of Chaos and Ethyreis for survival.

heroes.note: Build primarily with high critical damage and critical rate, followed by HP.

heroes.note: Equipped with Witch's Remains and needs roughly 50 Accuracy for Vortex 1.

heroes.note: New Season 9 support who significantly amplifies total team damage and shield consistency; can be replaced by Solmo if not owned.

heroes.name: Child of Chaos

heroes.name: Serpentemis

heroes.name: Sleight

heroes.name: Twitch
heroes.note: Acts as the Witch's Remains debuff applier wearing Mystic Conch.

teams.note: Level 59 Aura setup for Season 9 Week 1 tuned to an 18-second skill rotation. Celestine can be swapped for Solmo if necessary.
Level 59 Toxin setup for Season 9 Week 1 utilizing Puppeteer set on Child of Chaos and Ethyreis for total team survivability.

meta_changes: Aura and Toxin outperform Dauntless and Toxin in early Season 9 due to missing early-game crit rate conversion talents.
Celestine enters the meta as a premier support that greatly elevates Aura and Ice compositions.
tips: Prioritize Aura + Toxin rather than Dauntless + Toxin during the first week of Season 9.
Aim for roughly 50 Accuracy on Diantha when running Vortex 1.
Equip Child of Chaos with the Puppeteer set for optimal performance in the Toxin setup.
Serpentemis still needs around 20 Accuracy even with her 35% Accuracy requirement reduction.
If Celestine is unavailable, use Solmo as an Aura/Ice replacement; if Ethyreis is missing, Torrin can fill the defensive role.
